TC-20/S10.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 4/4, 2 record-only. Fresh account, no patients: Hospital 0/0/0/0 with 'No patients yet.'; Nursing Home 0/0/0/0 with 'No residents on today's visit list.'; no stuck loading, no 'being updated', no junk.
